Case_03004/figure4.jpg.source_caption: Valve tissue with hyphal invasion (silver stain).

description.short_caption: Valve tissue with hyphal invasion visualized using silver stain.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows valve tissue stained with a silver stain, highlighting fungal hyphae. The hyphae appear as dark, filamentous structures infiltrating the tissue. The background tissue is stained green, providing contrast to the fungal elements. The image demonstrates extensive fungal invasion, consistent with invasive fungal endocarditis.
visible_findings: silver stain technique highlighting fungal structures

Case_03004/figure3.jpg.source_caption: Valve tissue, septate hyphae on Wright’s stain.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of valve tissue showing septate hyphae on Wright's stain.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows valve tissue stained with Wright's stain. The tissue contains numerous septate hyphae, which are elongated fungal structures with visible septations. The hyphae are distributed throughout the tissue matrix, suggesting fungal invasion. The staining highlights the fungal morphology against the background tissue, aiding in identification.
